response.justification: Bogdan is a talented, versatile senior engineer with strong systems and web experience, but his career is overwhelmingly focused on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and D-lang work rather than Java/Kotlin/JVM enterprise tooling. There is no evidence of Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, IDE internals, or JVM-focused engineering, making him a poor match for this role's core technical requirements despite his general seniority and skill.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level experience across many domains and languages
Demonstrated ability to own complex systems end-to-end (low-latency services, GIS platform, mobile apps)
Strong communication and teaching skills (workshops, talks, mentoring)
concerns: No demonstrated Java or Kotlin experience in recent roles; Java only appears briefly years ago (Altom, robotic arms)
No experience with Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise JVM frameworks
No evidence of IDE internals or language tooling experience, a key focus area for this role

key_factors.factor: No IDE internals or language tooling background
